title: The Reasonable Reading
summary: Day 5, DOUBT. June gives the ordinary explanation, and it is a good one, and rule R5 says the player must never feel stupid for holding it. Written so that agreeing with her is the more intelligent-sounding option, because the alternative is a game that punishes scepticism. The player-side knowledge is deliberately NOT disproved by any branch: agreeing with June is expressed by the trait and the relationship, not by deleting a fact other content is gated on.
